Needed to detect when your Bluetooth headphones or neckband are connected.
Allows the app to detect incoming calls on WhatsApp, Messenger, or Phone and trigger the answer button when you click your headset key.
Prevents Android from killing the call monitoring service when your Bluetooth device is active.
Finish Setup and Go to Main App
Master Switch ON: App is monitoring for incoming calls via Bluetooth device.
Master Switch OFF: App background activities are completely stopped to save battery.
Auto-Answer ON: Calls will be answered automatically when detected.
Auto-Answer OFF: Calls will ONLY be answered when Bluetooth button is pressed.
Lock Screen ON: Button press receives calls when phone is locked.
Lock Screen OFF: Calls will not be received when phone is locked.
Unlocked Screen ON: Button press receives calls when phone is unlocked.
Unlocked Screen OFF: Calls will not be received when phone is unlocked.
Please connect your Bluetooth headphones or neckband first to activate the Master Service.
Monitors incoming call screens for standard dialers, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Telegram. Simulates answer action when Bluetooth headset media button is pressed. Safe and 100% offline.
Ready to answer incoming calls with connected Bluetooth button.
Master Service Switch. Automatically turns on when Bluetooth device connects, and turns off when disconnected to save battery.
Lock Screen Call Receive Switch. Controls whether headphone button answers calls when phone is locked.
Unlocked Screen Call Receive Switch. Controls whether headphone button answers calls when phone is unlocked.
Auto Answer Switch. When enabled, incoming calls will be answered automatically after a short delay without pressing a button.
Change Application Language. Double tap to select between English, Bengali, Spanish, French, or Hindi.
Re-run Setup Wizard. Double tap to review or grant Bluetooth, Accessibility, and Battery permissions.
Privacy Policy and Terms. Double tap to view 100% offline privacy and zero-data-collection policy.
Call answered successfully via Bluetooth button.

BT Receive Call is specifically designed as an assistive accessibility tool for blind and visually impaired individuals. It allows seamless, safe answering of incoming phone, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Telegram calls via Bluetooth headphone/neckband hardware buttons without needing to touch or locate on-screen buttons.
We respect your absolute privacy. The application does NOT collect, store, transmit, or share any personal information, contact lists, audio recordings, or call metadata with anyone.
This application operates completely offline on your device. It does not require or request Internet permissions (android.permission.INTERNET is completely absent).

The Android Accessibility Service is utilized strictly and exclusively to trigger the incoming call accept gesture upon receiving verified Bluetooth media button hardware events. No other screen interactions, keylogging, or background monitoring are performed.
